subject: general
question: Which of the following was the first official international step to protect the environment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stockholm conference**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Stockholm Convention **is a **global treaty **that aims to **protect human health**.
 
• **To protect **the **environment **from the **effects of persistent organic pollutants **(POPs).
 
• The **Convention **entered into **force on May 17, 2004**.

 The **United Nations Conference **on the **Human Environment **was **held in Stockholm**, **Sweden**, from **June 5–16 in 1972**.
 
• The **principal purpose **was **to serve as a practical means to encourage, and to provide guidelines to protect and improve the human environment and to remedy and prevent its effect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Nairobi Declaration**, adopted by **African ministers **and **heads of delegations November 19, 2021**, underlined the need to **deliver commitments **on the **Programme of Action **(PoA) for **implementing **the **Sendai Framework in Africa**.
 
• **Earth Summit **was created as a **response for member states **to cooperate together **internationally on development issues after the Cold War**.
 
• **Vienna Convention **on the **Law of Treaties**, an **international agreement governing treaties **between **states that was drafted by the International Law Commission **of the **United Nations.**
